title: feat(nm2frm2lpf): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then +e1 at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Bare L-path (-e3,+e1) on the far-face seed; fourth and last of the far-face block, all sharing the one cause. On this seed the +e1 turn destination (1,0,-1) is split-good (tick 1, single incoming), unlike the near-face seed - so the far-face pair does not reproduce the near-face +e1 collision.
